Glad you got it working. I saved a note to the project's EngramDB memory that newer wkhtmltopdf versions need `--enable-local-file-access` for the invoice PDF tests. The next session that hits this failure will find it right away.

Git showed no uncommitted changes when this session started. If your fix is only in your local setup and not in the repo, CI and other developers on newer wkhtmltopdf will hit the same failure. It may be worth committing the flag wherever the PDF options are set.
